blocks.intro: Elmhurst emergencies tend to follow the weather.

items.body: Like April 2013, when 7.26 inches fell in two days.
Pipes along exterior walls freeze first.
Hard water and age take their toll.

blocks.h2: What You Get When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Take five minutes now. Find the main water shutoff, usually in the basement near the meter. Make sure it turns. Find the gas shutoff at the meter outside. Check that your sump pump runs when you pour water into the pit. Save our number in your phone. When something goes wrong at night, those few steps save time and limit damage.

blocks.h2: The Emergencies Elmhurst Homeowners Call About Most
blocks.body: Most of our urgent calls in Elmhurst fall into a few groups: sump pumps that stop during heavy rain, sewer backups through the basement floor drain, water heaters that leak without warning and pipes that freeze in garages or outside walls. Each one has a quick first step you can take, like shutting off the water or checking the pump's power, while we're on the way.

blocks.h2: Emergency Plumbing Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.answer: Yes. Our phone line is open around the clock.

items.q: My water heater is leaking. What do I do first?
items.preview: Shut off its cold water valve and power or gas.
items.answer: Close the cold water valve on top of the heater and turn off its power or gas. Then call us.

items.preview: Usually in the basement near the meter.
items.answer: In most Elmhurst homes, it's in the basement where the water line comes in, near the meter.

items.q: Will I see the price first?
items.answer: Yes. You'll approve a flat-rate price before work begins.

items.q: How fast can you get here?
items.answer: Arrival times depend on the day and weather, but we work to get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Should I shut off the water heater if the main is off?
items.answer: If the water will be off for a while, turn the heater to vacation or pilot.
